test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 29th November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the sequence.

_ P _ L I P _ L _ _ N L
solution:
Given sequence: _ P _ L I P _ L _ _ N L

 
• PNLLI → **P** P **N** L - I P **L** L - **L I** N L
 
• INNIP → **I** P **N** L - I P **N** L - **I P** N L
 
• IPPIP → **I** P **P** L - I P **P** L - **I P **N L
 
• INLII → **I** P **N** L - I P **L** L - **I I** N L

 
• In option 2, IPNL is repeated.

Hence, '**INNIP**' is the correct answer.
